name: UK inflation & rates
summary: Bank Rate 4% after the 5 Nov rise; CPI 3.5% in September, Bank expects about 5% by mid-2027; October CPI due 18 Nov
state: UK CPI inflation was 3.5% in the 12 months to September, inside the 2.5–4.0% Watch band. The Bank of England raised Bank Rate by 0.25 points to 4% on 5 Nov on an 8–1 vote and projects CPI of about 5% by mid-2027 as energy costs feed through (Bank of England). Deputy Governor Lombardelli said on 10 Nov that another near-term rise was likely unless inflation pressures clearly weaken. October CPI is due on 18 Nov; a print above 4% would cross the Alert line.
for_you: Households on tracker or variable mortgages saw costs rise after 5 Nov, and fixed-rate deals coming up for renewal are likely to cost more. Rising prices continue to squeeze real incomes.
rubric_hit: CPI 3.5% within 2.5–4.0% Watch band; BoE reversed course with 5 Nov rise

rubric.alert: CPI > 4.0%, or an emergency BoE move.
rubric.watch: CPI 2.5–4.0%, or the BoE reversing course.
rubric.normal: CPI ≤ 2.5% and Bank of England moving gradually or on hold.
